# A plan outside git: init, add, show, ls, move, tags, next, brief, json.
$ wk
$ wk init
$ wk init --store nowhere
$ wk init --store ignore
$ wk init --store repo
$ wk init --store home
$ wk add "Water the plants"
$ wk add "Water the plants"
$ wk add "Water all the plants" --force --tags garden,quick
$ wk add "Fix the gate latch" --tags bug --body "It sticks.\nUse oil."
$ wk add "Paint the fence" --when later --tags gardn
$ wk add "Repaint the shed someday" --when someday
$ wk add "A title that is far far far too long to fit in the seventy character limit"
$ wk add
$ wk ls
$ wk ls --json
$ wk ls bug
$ wk ls later
$ wk ls nothing-here
$ wk tags
$ wk tags --json
$ wk next
$ wk next --json
$ wk show zz
$ wk show "not an id!"
$ wk move
$ wk move yebg
$ wk move yebg --top
$ wk move xcma --when next
$ wk move m7sw --before 4yrm
$ wk move m7sw --when queue
$ wk move 4yrm --after m7sw
$ wk move 4yrm --top --bottom
$ wk move aes8 --when "on:2026-12-01"
$ wk move aes8 --when "on:2026-13-01"
$ wk move aes8 --when soonish
$ wk ls queued
$ wk show yebg
$ wk show yebg --json
$ wk show y --all
$ wk brief
$ wk brief --json
$ wk config
$ wk config --json
$ wk summary
$ wk summary "Name: Garden jobs\nWho: me"
$ wk summary
$ wk frobnicate
